description:
## BannerHub v6 1.0.2-631 > ⚠️ **Read before installing — USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.** BannerHub v6 is a **separate project** from BannerHub 3.7.x and BannerHub Lite (own package names, keystore, and backend) — they do **not** update over one another, and v6 is a **work in progress, barely tested**, with different game compatibility. Full details below. ⤵
⚠️ Important — separate projects & compatibility (click to expand) **BannerHub v6 does NOT replace BannerHub 3.7.x or BannerHub Lite — they are SEPARATE projects.** - **BannerHub** 3.7.x — built from the GameHub 5.3.5 ReVanced project by **PlayDay**. - **BannerHub Lite** — built from GameHub Lite 5.1.4 by **Producdevity**. - **BannerHub v6** *(this repo)* — built from XiaoJi GameHub 6.0.x on a brand-new pipeline. **None of the three are to be updated over by any of the others.** Each ships with its own package names, its own keystore, and its own component / Steam-client backend — Android won't accept an in-place update between them, and forcing one will leave you with a broken install. Uninstall first, then install the new project if you want to switch. Keep in mind **BannerHub v6 is still a work in progress** and will re-release frequently as new base GameHub versions come out from XiaoJi upstream. **Compatibility is different** — don't expect every game that works on BannerHub 3.7.x or Lite to work on v6, and vice versa. v6 uses a **new component system and new Steam clients** and, thus far, has been **barely tested in general**. **USE AT YOUR OWN RISK.**
A patched build of **XiaoJi GameHub 6.3.1** that removes the login requirement (import and play games with no account), serves **its own PC Engine plugin**, and redirects the catalog + firmware to the BannerHub Cloudflare Worker. Ships **9 variants that install side-by-side**. **9 APKs attached.** Steam and GOG game launches work end-to-end on the 6.3.1 base. > **No separate Lite builds.** XiaoJi's own size pass plus the privacy/size strips folded into every variant make a distinct Lite pointless — the Lite concept stays absorbed. 🔒 **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level. Full list of killed channels (and the honest leftovers) in [`PRIVACY.md`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-631-build/PRIVACY.md).
✨ Everything BannerHub v6 offers (click to expand) - **No login required** — launch straight to the home screen and import/play games without a XiaoJi account (on 6.3.1 a synthetic account is seeded so the PC Engine plugin is happy too). - **BannerHub-served PC Engine plugin** — the 6.1+ runtime plugin is re-signed and patched by BannerHub and delivered from the BannerHub API; catalog and firmware go through the Worker, firmware downloads are forced to HTTP/1.1, the launch badge is back. - **Custom catalog API** — **curated component delivery** (hand-picked DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, Box64, FEX, Mesa Turnip driver builds, etc.) instead of the stock upstream set. - **Component Manager** *(new)* — inject your own `.wcp` components or GPU-driver `.zip`s, or download them from the online repos, and use them from the normal pickers; remove in one tap. - **Full GOG store** *(new)* — Store / Library / Downloads / Profile, catalog browse + search, detail pages with media, Bannerlator's Rust download engine. - **Privacy-hardened** — upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level (see the `PRIVACY.md` link above for the full list). - **PC-accurate controller vibration** — real XInput rumble routed into Android's VibratorManager with independent dual-motor support, configurable **per-game** via the **PC Vibration Settings** menu row. Preload-free. - **In-game Steam · Friends overlay** — friends list, chat and invites from inside the game, now over a main-process relay that suits the plugin architecture. - **BannerHub Explore homepage** — the bottom-nav "Explore" tab opens a BannerHub-owned homepage: "What's New" synced from the release notes, the GOG store card, Banner Tools, and an in-app **update banner + installed-vs-latest version readout**. - **In-game performance HUD + overlay** *(root for the clock controls)* — live DXVK/GPU/CPU/RAM/power/thermal/FPS readout and a slide-out panel for governor + Adreno clock toggles. - **9 side-by-side variants** — different package names + launcher labels so multiple builds coexist on one device (`Original` replaces stock GameHub; the rest install alongside it). - **Root-free file manager access** — a content provider lets MT Manager and similar apps browse GameHub's data dir without root. - **Installs in place** — public signing keystore; BannerHub v6 stables upgrade without uninstalling (see the 6.0.9 → 6.3.1 note below). - **BannerHub v6 branding** — custom app icon, Wine container header, and auth/splash artwork. - **Triage-friendly** — debuggable build with logcat markers along the import path.
## What's new in 1.0.2-631 1.0.2 and 1.0.1 are fix releases on the 6.3.1 line (details first below). The 631 headline: **BannerHub v6 now runs on XiaoJi GameHub 6.3.1** (versionCode 141), up from the 6.0.9 base (versionCode 121) of `v1.0.0-609`. Since 6.1.0 the whole Wine runtime, launch screen and component system live in a separately-downloaded **PC Engine plugin**, and 6.3.x added XiaoJi's community/social layer, a newer Steam stack and transactional cloud sync. Every BannerHub patch was **re-derived against 6.3.1 and confirmed on-device**, and the plugin side is now BannerHub's too. ### 🩹 1.0.2-631 — install conflict when upgrading from 609 (or next to stock GameHub) Fixes **"App not installed as package conflicts with an existing package"** when installing a 631 build over `v1.0.0-609`, or on any device that also has **stock GameHub 6.1+** (or another GameHub 6.x mod signed with a different key). The 6.1+ base declares a new push permission, `com.xiaoji.egggame.push.permission.MESSAGE`, outside the name pattern our per-variant rename covered, so every 631 variant still declared it under XiaoJi's name — and Android refuses to install a package that redeclares a permission owned by a differently-signed app. Every `com.xiaoji.egggame.*` permission is now renamed per variant (declarations, requests, and the two receiver guards). Device-proven: 609 → 1.0.2 in place. Same plugin (111-7), same firmware, same keystore. Nothing else changed since 1.0.1-631. ### 🩹 1.0.1-631 — Component Manager removal fixes Two bugs found right after 1.0.0-631, both in the remove → re-inject path: - **Removing a component no longer breaks the games that used it.** The PC Engine wires the selected translator / DXVK into each game prefix as symlinks and never re-points an existing one, so after a Remove those links dangled and the game died on launch (`could not load libarm64ec_import.dll`, Wine exit 53). Remove — and opening Component Manager — now clears dead links; the engine plants fresh ones on the next launch. - **Re-injecting a component you removed no longer claims it "already exists".** The name check read a stale in-process copy of the plugin registry; it now reads the registry file fresh, tells catalog rows from injected ones, and silently heals an orphaned row instead of prompting. Device-proven: inject → use → remove → re-inject (no prompt) → launch. Nothing else changed since 1.0.0-631; same plugin (111-7), same firmware, same keystore — installs in place. ### 🔁 Rebased onto GameHub 6.3.1 (versionCode 141) The 6.1.0 and 6.1.1 lines were onboarded but never shipped as stables; 6.3.1 is where everything landed. The usual R8 reshuffle broke most anchors; all were re-derived structurally — the per-game menu keystone first, then the Banner Tools row, Show PC Game Settings, Bypass login, Debug logging, the Explore tab hijack, the catalog + `/v6` redirects, the perf overlay, the vibration resolver and the privacy strips. Two obsolete PC-engine signature patches were retired. ### 🔌 BannerHub-served PC Engine plugin The host downloads a **PC Engine plugin** (schema 7 on 6.3.1) and only accepts what its manifest names. BannerHub v6 serves **its own re-signed, patched 6.3.1 plugin** from the BannerHub API: catalog + firmware via the Worker (`/v6p`), firmware forced to HTTP/1.1 (upstream's downloader corrupted imagefs over multiplexed HTTP/2), the launch badge restored, and loader hooks so host-injected components appear in every picker. Plugin updates arrive automatically on app start. Firmware stays pinned at 1.4.2 and **no previously released BannerHub or v6 build is affected**. ### 🛒 Full GOG store with the Rust download engine GOG login is fixed (no more white screen after sign-in) and the GOG screen is now a **full store** ported from Bannerlator: Store / Library / Downloads / Profile tabs, catalog browse + search, Steam-style detail pages with media, generation badges from GOG's content system, and downloads on Bannerlator's **Rust engine** with staged, verified chunked transfers (57 MB/s measured on device). Games land in your library and launch like any other PC game. ### 🧩 Component Manager — inject your own components New **Components** tile in Banner Tools, at parity with BannerHub 3.8.1's injector: inject any `.wcp` (DXVK, VKD3D, FEX/Box64 translators, libs; tar + zstd / xz) or a GPU-driver `.zip` from storage, or pull them from the same six online repos plus the Turnip Nightlies from a **Download** screen. Injected components register with the plugin, appear in the right picker next to the catalog, and are removable in one tap. Device-proven end-to-end: a game ran on an injected Turnip driver, an injected DXVK and an injected FEX nightly simultaneously; removal leaves no ghost entries. ### 💬 Steam · Friends overlay rebuilt for the plugin era The game now runs inside the plugin process, so the overlay has a new transport: a relay service in the main app process (attaches in ~130 ms) with an IPC fallback for invites, and it never blocks the UI thread. Steam sign-in, the Friends list and online play are confirmed on 6.3.1; **chat send/receive and voice calls have not been re-verified on this base yet**. ### 🔐 Login bypass that survives the plugin The plugin reads the signed-in user from the Room database, so Bypass login **seeds a synthetic account** through Room's bundled SQLite driver. Clean install → first launch → game running with no account is confirmed. The heartbeat/token calls that used to log the fake account out are answered by the Worker. ### Carryover — what still works, what is paused Explore tab, Banner Tools (**Vibration · Game ID · Audio · GOG · Overlay · Root · Components**), the in-game performance HUD + root pill, PC-accurate vibration, the privacy stack, the 9 variants and the public keystore carry over. **Paused on 6.3.1** (host anchors gone): the **offline component picker** (the plugin owns the pickers now) and the **recording-compatible audio** toggle (the Audio tile is present; that switch does nothing on this base). The heartbeat-disable patch is moot since the Worker handles heartbeat. > ⚠️ **Upgrading from `v1.0.0-609`:** same signing key, so Android accepts an in-place update, but the 6.0.9 → 6.3.1 database migration is XiaoJi's and **we have not tested it**. A clean install is recommended; sign in to Steam and GOG again afterwards.
📥 Variants & install notes (9 side-by-side APKs) Each variant has its own package name + launcher label, so the variants install **side-by-side** with each other. `Original` replaces an installed GameHub; the rest install alongside it. If a package name is already on your device under a different signing key (e.g. `com.tencent.ig` used by another emulator build), Android reports a package conflict — pick a different variant. | Variant | Package | APK | | --- | --- | --- | | Normal | `banner.hub` | `…-Normal.apk` | | Normal-GHL | `gamehub.lite` | `…-Normal-GHL.apk` | | PuBG | `com.tencent.ig` | `…-PuBG.apk` | | AnTuTu | `com.antutu.ABenchMark` | `…-AnTuTu.apk` | | alt-AnTuTu | `com.antutu.benchmark.full` | `…-alt-AnTuTu.apk` | | PuBG-CrossFire | `com.tencent.tmgp.cf` | `…-PuBG-CrossFire.apk` | | Ludashi | `com.ludashi.aibench` | `…-Ludashi.apk` | | Genshin | `com.miHoYo.GenshinImpact` | `…-Genshin.apk` | | Original | `com.xiaoji.egggame` | `…-Original.apk` | Filenames follow `BannerHub-V6-1.0.2-631-Patched-{variant}.apk`. The version string is `BannerHub v6` (product) + our semver + `-631` (the GameHub base, `6.3.1`) — e.g. `1.0.2-631`. ### Install notes - **Signing**: public BannerHub test keystore, unchanged since `v1.1.0-604`. Fingerprints in [`keystore/README.md`](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-631-build/keystore/README.md). - **First launch needs network**: the app downloads the BannerHub PC Engine plugin (~27 MB) and, on first game launch, the firmware. - Base APK is unmodified XiaoJi GameHub 6.3.1 (versionCode 141) — only the bytecode/resources the patches need are touched. - The `.rvp` / `.rve` bundles are attached for use with `revanced-cli` directly. Built with ReVanced CLI 6.0.0; APKs from `gamehub-631-build`.
📦 Patches applied (click to expand) | Patch | What it does | | --- | --- | | **Bypass login** | Launch straight to the home screen; import and play games with no account. On 6.3.1 also seeds the synthetic account into Room so the PC Engine plugin accepts downloads. | | **Redirect PC engine plugin manifest** | Points the plugin manifest lookup at the BannerHub API, which serves the BannerHub-patched plugin per schema version. | | **PC engine plugin — validation strategy** | Lets the host accept the BannerHub-signed plugin. | | **Redirect catalog API** + **Prefix API path with /v6** | Points the catalog at the BannerHub Worker without affecting 5.x clients; also fixes PC-settings rendering in portrait. | | **Component Manager** | Banner Tools → Components: inject `.wcp` / driver `.zip`, online-repo Download screen, list + remove; registers with the plugin. | | **GOG store + Rust engine** | Full GOG store UI, fixed login WebView, bundled `libblsteam.so` download engine. | | **Steam · Friends relay service** + **Steam chat overlay** | Main-process relay + invite IPC so the in-game overlay works with the plugin-hosted game. | | **Disable Firebase Crashlytics** | Prevents a launch-time `VerifyError` crash. | | **Debug logging** | Debuggable APK + logcat markers along the import path for triage. | | **File manager access** | Content provider so external file managers can browse the data dir without root. | | **Rewrite custom permissions per variant** | Stops two installed variants colliding on Android 7+. | | **PC-accurate vibration** + **PC Vibration Settings** | XInput rumble into Android's VibratorManager (independent dual-motor), per-game mode + intensity, strict per-game store. | | **Show PC Game Settings row** | Keeps the per-game **PC game settings** row visible in Explorer view. | | **Explore tab hijack** | The BannerHub Explore homepage. | | **Performance HUD / overlay** | In-game readout + root clock controls. | | **Privacy hardening** | Upstream telemetry/analytics channels stripped at the bytecode level. Full list + honest leftovers in `PRIVACY.md`. | | **Change app icon** / **Change package & app name** *(per variant)* | BannerHub v6 branding; per-variant package + launcher label. | | **Privacy/size strips** | Removes the Aliyun carrier-login (NumberAuth) SDK and the Haima cloud-gaming stack from every variant. | | *Paused on 6.3.1* | **Offline component picker**, **Recording-compatible audio**, **Disable heartbeat** — host anchors gone; kept in the tree, gated off. | *Per-patch mechanics, smali anchors, and version-by-version letter maps are in the [README's Patches applied section](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-631-build/README.md#patches-applied) and the [patch sources](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/tree/gamehub-631-build/patches/src/main/kotlin/app/revanced/patches/gamehub).*
### Credits **Voice-chat testing:** huge thanks to **Glitch** and **Stevolit** for the many cross-network test calls that helped get in-game 1:1 + party voice working and confirmed across different ISPs/NATs. 🙏 PC-accurate controller vibration (including the preload-free rework) is built on **[TideGear](https://github.com/TideGear)**'s [GameHub-Vibration-Fix](https://github.com/TideGear/GameHub-Vibration-Fix) (PR #80 + PR #91), adapted with explicit permission, deriving from [GameNative](https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative) (PR #1214). Full project credits (DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, Box64, FEX, Mesa Turnip, ReVanced, etc.) are in the [README Credits section](https://github.com/The412Banner/bannerhub-revanced/blob/gamehub-631-build/README.md#credits).
